visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a black and white shot of a young man wearing glasses and a pinstripe suit jacket over a white T-shirt, holding and drinking from a glass. Large white text overlays his face. (2) The scene transitions to full color, showing a green backdrop with the words '仲夏夜摘星會' (Midsummer Night Star-Picking Banquet). Close-up shots of high-end food appear, including a dish topped with orange roe and soup served in a coconut shell. (3) The man is shown eating the soup with a spoon, his eyes looking upwards in a gesture of appreciation. The background is a dimly lit, upscale restaurant environment. (4) A split-screen displays a female performer in a black dress playing the violin in the top half, while the bottom half shows the man's focused reaction. (5) Detailed close-ups of risotto and a dark, glazed dish (possibly abalone) are shown. The man continues to eat enthusiastically with a fork. (6) Another split-screen features a man in a tuxedo playing a keyboard/piano. The main character watches, looking pleasantly surprised. (7) The setting shifts to an indoor room with warmer lighting. The man holds up two sealed plastic bags containing dental testing materials. He demonstrates how to use a white U-shaped bite plate by placing it in his mouth and biting down. (8) He speaks directly to the camera, using hand gestures to explain the process against a blurry green background. (9) The final shot is a graphic end screen featuring a photo of him eating, brand logos, and social media links.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a bouncy, upbeat pizzicato string BGM. It has a light, curious feel. No voices are present initially. (2) A sharp 'shing' or sparkle sound effect triggers as food visuals appear. The music remains steady in tempo. (3) Rhythmic slurping sound effects (human vocal SFX) are layered over the BGM, synchronized with the man eating. (4) A melodic violin line enters, complementing the pizzicato BGM. The overall acoustic brightness increases. (5) Fast-paced 'gulp' and 'bite' sound effects are mixed prominently during the montage of the man eating various dishes. (6) Soft piano chords are heard alongside the violin, creating a sophisticated layers of instrumentation. (7) The BGM ducks as the man's clear, articulated male voice begins the narration. High-frequency rustling of plastic bags is audible as he moves items. (8) A dull mechanical click sound occurs when the man bites the dental plate. The narration continues with positive inflection and a moderate speech rate. (9) The BGM swells slightly for the final 3 seconds, ending with a clean fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creator's high-end dining experience at a 10,000 NTD banquet while simultaneously promoting a dental clinic. The intent is to generate interest in the lavish lifestyle aspect and pivot to a dental bite-strength test sponsored by the clinic.
